headline: Oil eases from five-month highs after Trump waives some Russia sanctions, pulling the 10-year yield to about 5.09% and lifting Nasdaq futures ~1% ahead of Meta and Tesla earnings Wednesday.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield slipped to about 5.085% early Monday as oil fell, but yields remain high and have pressured tech.
fed: The Fed is in its blackout period with no speakers this week; markets price about 88% hold / 12% hike for the Oct 27-28 FOMC and roughly 75-80% odds of a hike by December.
oil: Brent fell about 2% to ~$107.6 and WTI to ~$99.5 after Trump's Oct 16 order waived some Russia sanctions, but Hormuz tanker attacks and mines keep Gulf exports near 8.5M bpd vs 20M+ before, holding crude near $100+.
geo: Iran-linked attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz continue (another tanker hit a mine), while the US Russia-sanctions waiver is under a review of up to 60 days.
